dataset.title: Database of a 4-km seismic and electric streamer survey: the embankment of the Po River near Crescentino, Piedmont, Italy

Resistivity_data.csv.gz.role: Complete original CSV bytes, losslessly recompressed as gzip for stdlib offline reading

Electrodes_Positions.csv.gz.role: Complete original CSV bytes, losslessly recompressed as gzip for stdlib offline reading

selection: First acquisition station only: measurement numbers 1-318 and electrode global IDs 1-13. Selected by acquisition index before fitting or inspecting target quality.

units.repeatability: percent standard deviation reported by the instrument, not complete measurement/model uncertainty
units.electrode_coordinates: metres, EPSG:32632; no elevation in supplied electrode CSV
units.model_coordinates: nominal instrument spacing on a flat local line, metres

processing: Extract both CSV members from the fixed 7z archive without text/line-ending changes; gzip.compress(source_bytes,mtime=0).
Preserve all original observation and coordinate rows in compressed fixtures.
Compute signed geometric factors from nominal instrument positions and compare Rho to K * voltage/current within decimal-rounding bounds.
Reject two nonpositive apparent-resistivity rows for log-domain inversion only; do not drop negative voltages whose signs are consistent with electrode orientation.
Fit a flat, isotropic, horizontally layered two-layer model with pyGIMLi VESModelling and log-domain inversion.
Group equivalent/reciprocal quadrupoles in a fixed geometry-only holdout; fit training data only.
error_model: Assign log-domain sigma = hypot(reported_repeatability_percent / 100, 0.03), combining the reported fractional repeatability with a separately assumed log-scale term. Treat log errors as independent Gaussian for a conditional nominal chi-square diagnostic. This is not a measured total field uncertainty; report rejection if residuals exceed it.
limitations: No true subsurface resistivity or thickness is known. Field fit/holdout never establish geological recovery.
Nominal electrode positions used by instrument differ from the surveyed UTM positions; retain both and report the flat-geometry simplification.
Zero reported repeatability does not mean zero measurement error.
Independent two-layer image-series synthetic data test controlled recovery separately from field observations.
